title: How a nature camp gets planned
storyboard: Film: camp lead at a table with site map, species list and sticky notes; over-shoulder + close-ups

scenes.headline: Planning a nature camp starts with one question
What can kids actually see here, this season?
List what lives near the site, then build sessions around it
Common kingfishers nest in tunnels dug into steep banks
scenes.body: So a riverbank walk becomes a lesson - watched from a distance.

scenes.headline: Nature study camps, planned around real wildlife

caption:
Every camp session starts as a species list

Common kingfishers hunt from a perch above the water, then dive in to grab prey and fly back out.

Source: Animal Diversity Web. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: BTS of camp design: species list first, sessions second. Grid photos are illustrative, not a claim about any site; planning steps to be confirmed by Muddy Lessons. Kingfisher clips are common kingfishers (Alcedo atthis).
